one: The public lecture series of the Transformer universe: one top researcher each week on LLMs, generation, robotics, and science.
pos: CS 25 is one of Stanford's most popular 1-unit seminars, with speakers from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, NVIDIA, and elsewhere. There are no assignments — attendance is enough — and lectures are streamed and recorded, making it a fast way to scan the frontier.
prereq: Basic deep learning and Transformer knowledge (understand attention), or CS 224N/CS 231N/CS 230.
assess: 1 unit, S/NC, attendance only; no assignments.
who: Anyone — students, engineers, and researchers who want a low-cost way to track the frontier; also useful as group-meeting or course supplementary material.
tips: You can watch the YouTube recordings without enrolling. Write down three takeaways per talk, or you will forget them.
note: CS 25 is not offered in the 2026–27 ExploreCourses listing; the cross-listed SYMSYS 25 is offered in Spring 2027. CS 25 has run many times before, and lecture recordings are on YouTube.
